nom: The Ordinary Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Serum for Oily Skin

avis.texte: I was dealing with fungal acne on my face that was so itchy and uncomfortable. My skin on my nose was so irritated and sensitive, I learned zinc is good for fungal acne issues so I started using this every other day/every few days and it has truly saved my skin. I have been using it for 6 weeks now and since I incorporated this into my skincare routine I have not dealt with that fungal acne since. It also has helped control how oily my T Zone often gets. I feel like over time I have begun to see a difference in the discoloration in my cheeks too, but that was never too bad to begin with for me. This product has not pilled under my moisturizer and sunscreen. I do not wear makeup so I cannot attest to it pilling then, but I find the formula and feeling is fine. My skin does not feel tingly or weird when I use it either. I am about 2/3 through the bottle after 6 weeks at 3 to 4 uses per week. Absolutely worth it.
Got this for my 18 year old son who is also on Trentoin for acne. He says it does its job!

i have oily skin and this serum never fails. i will either layer it with a gel mositurizer (for oily skin) or just apply toner and this serum. it is a great afforable staple to have in your skin care routine.
Been using this and other Ordinary serums for years with no problems, but this product caused burning , tingling, and itching on my face. Had to wash it off immediately. So disappointing.

My husband has had rosacea for many years. We were so used to the discoloration we didn't realize it was scars. It helped even out his skin tone. He applies it twice a day after washing his face. I have a cluster of acne scars along my cheek with uneven skin. This has significantly improved the texture and and removed the scars. I wish i started using this product sooner. I apply nightly after washing my face.
This product did nothing for me. I can feel the serum being absorbed into my skin, but there were no results. I will try another Ordinary serum to try and match my needs.
i have combo/acne prone skin, and this product helped so much with brightening my skin and reducing shine on my face! such a great product for such a affordable price! x
So so so good I love this product for my acne it's really helped

This serum has cleared up my hormonal acne skin so well!! I pair it with The Ordinary natural moisturizing factor and my oily skin doesn't aggravate me anymore!! I can tell that it has minimized my pores and created a little bit of brightening on my face. I will buy again!

After about 3 weeks of incorporating this product i am seeing real results. The pores on my nose are less visible and my jawline has seriously cleared up on closed / clogged pores! Not perfect yet but skincare is only half the battle. Trick to using this product is making sure its the only niacinamide containing product in your routine & applying it only when your skin can tolerate. I use a gentle gel cleanser only (no actives) the zinc serum, then i apply the ordinary aloe and nag serum as a light moisturizer and spf if needed. I do a double cleanse and thebordinary mandelic at night (mind you their mandelic is 10% - i started at 5% then worked my way up to 8% now i can do 10%, i would NOT start with the 10%). I also use their pwder to cream sulfur spot treatment & it's literally the best sulfur product ive ever tried.

avis.titre: Beware if you are sensitive! But it's amazing!
avis.texte: This serum really helps with my skin! My pores have been rapidly vanishing out of sight and my skin doesn't really even get oily anymore due to this product. Quick warning, it is a strong product and for those with more sensitive skin it might be a little too strong and cause breakouts. I hate recommended it to my sister, saying that it helped me with pores and acne, but when she wore it it caused break outs due to some acne treatments she was doing at the time. I've got combination skin, and it does cause some further dryness on those parts of my face, but it is really quite easy compared to doing a face mask every other day. The packaging is also quite nice, and I was glad I could take it on my trip. I haven't been able to break it even though I dropped it. Overall, it is a wonderful product, but just know your face.

I have been using this for the last year or so (along with other skin care products: retinol, matrixyl, argeriline) and I have been getting so many compliments on my skin. I dont know whether it is just this product ir combination if all others, but I am not changing my skincare routine as it is working for me

avis.titre: I had hope.. now I'm trashing it

Also does not seem to react well with other skin care products as ive never dealt with piling until this serum. I have read in depth all the things not to do to avoid every issue I have just incase it is user error on my part but by process of elimination I feel I can confidently say it is not user error and is in fact just the product. I did a lot of reading and seems many have these same issues with the ordinary brand niacinimide that I am having. I have about 8 other ordinary products I swear by so this was devastating for this one to be so horrible.

I decided to try this product in hopes that it will help reduce the pores on my nose. I use it with Hyaluronic Acid 2% 2x a day. It is easy to use and my skin seems to like the combo. It's only been two weeks so it's too early to tell if its working.
I love that they found a new larger packaging for the product. I loved it. And it's my favorite serum. ⭐️

Ok so I noticed theres VERY mixed reviews about this; keep in mind that not all acne is the same. I have developed acne at 37 yrs old due to pre menopause/aging. Someone who has acne at 14, or from PCOS, or even because they dont cleanse their face effectively is all different and different things work for different types. This product personally did nothing for me. It didnt help help my acne, didnt lighten any hyperpigmentation from past acne (which high strength niacinamide should do) and you have to use tons of product to cover your face because as soon as it hits the skin it pretty much absorbs completely. Additionally, it leaves such a sticky film on the face that makes my foundation look terrible. I will never use this again.

Such a let down that this caused my skin to react bad , i love taking care of my skin and hope these bumps go away soon!

I use this all the time everyday, my skin has been a lot clearer!

I do believe it reduced my pores a bit, but I will not continue because of the new breakouts I keep experiencing.

I have been using this product for roughly 4 months since starting my Korean skincare journey. I have noticed a significant difference in my skin. I had super oily and problematic skin that I would have to treat day and night with benzoyl peroxide. When I first transitioned from that regimen to the new one, I had bad breakouts. But I continued and after about 2 weeks, my skin was doing good. Now, I get by with using the benzoyl peroxide lotion occasionally and I think that is because my moisture barrier is restored. I have tried other serums by Byoma and so far the ordinary has been my favorite in my routine. It is very light weight and refreshing. I do believe it reduces inflammation. I also suffer from itchy scalp and dandruff sometimes. After using a dandruff shampoo, my scalp was still itchy in one spot, so I decided to try this serum on my scalp. Lo and behold, it worked! I was shocked because that one spot would be itchy after shampooing often and one application with the serum stopped it. So I do believe that this product helps to reduce skin inflammation. It does something lol I would recommend you try it.

This serum has been a staple in my skincare routine for 6+ years now, and it's my favorite TO product to date because it is literally the ONLY thing that has ever had any effect on my incredibly oily skin. I love trying new products, but the niacinamide + zinc is the one thing I absolutely do not want to be without. It took weeks of consistent use (3 drops in the AM and PM), and I did experience some mild purging in the first couple of months, but I went from needing to blot my face every 1-2 hours to occasionally needing to blot once or twice a day! I've also noticed fewer breakouts (I used to get painful cystic acne along my jawline, which rarely happens anymore). To anyone who is considering adding this to their skincare routine: definitely do a patch test first. Also, crosscheck the ingredients list with any other products that you use to make sure that everything will play well together. Some products can cause irritation if used together, while others can actually make each other less effective. (There are apps that can help with this.)

avis.titre: Great for my sensitive, acne prone skin
avis.texte: I am in my 30's and have annoyingly sensitive and acne prone skin that is also somehow oily and dry at the same time. Basically, all of the problems. My skin has loved this product. I layer it on bare skin under my moisturizer in the morning and it helps control excess oil all day. My acne has also lessened over time, although it is not totally gone. My pores seem a bit more refined and redness reduced. I actually have been skipping makeup for the past few days because my skin is looking so nice (and I am at usually a bad skin time of the month, iykyk). Best of all, no bad reaction at all to this product for my ultra sensitive skin. Only negative is that it does sometimes pill if I apply it when my skin is oily already at all, so it has to be applied to freshly washed skin only. I've repurchased this many times.

I have oily skin, and with that comes breakouts. I especially get hormonal breakouts around my chin. This stuff is amazing! A little goes a long way. I would recommend a pea size amount directly onto the forehead and distribute from there. Beware of under the nose and around the eyes. If it's an excessive amount of acne, discontinue.
